name: Dog Online
summary: Dog Online is a browser based point-and-click RPG in which you can adopt multiple Dogs. These dogs can go on perilous adventures, go fishing, work on the farm, be fed gourmet meals, and much more. While engaging with the activities of Dog Online, your active dog will level up their stats, allowing them to equip powerful combat items. Dogs can be also dressed up to be displayed on their customizable Dog Pages.
